text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
(...Yeah, I still have plenty left in the 
legs.)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
(Alright, on the final stretch—I'll settle 
this!)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Miiileeer!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey, hey, hey! You've gotta be kidding 
me?! Her speed is—on a whole different 
level!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
In the lead is Gran Alegria! Gran Alegria 
was just on another level!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa, Gran-chan is so fast! I can't 
believe she's that faaaast...!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! She zoomed right past in a 
flash! It was just a split second! It was 
so intense~!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ehehe!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
S-She has room to spare, doesn't she... 
Gran Alegria really is way too strong...!

text_block_list.name: Observing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Gran-chan is so strong...! I want to 
become just like Gran-chan too!

With her dazzling running, Gran Alegria 
left a profound shock on all the 
spectators, from veterans to newcomers 
alike.

Truly, just like a scorching sun burning 
everything to ash—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Wah...! Standing here, it looks six miles 
more spectacular~!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all for your support! To those 
watching for the first time, did you feel 
the intensity?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! Gran-chan, you were seriously, 
seriously amazing!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I'm so happy to get 5 miles♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
—With this, following the Yasuda Kinen, 
she has now conquered the Sprinters Stakes 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
All that remains is the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, bear witness to this historic 
moment... Watch us conquer all three 
divisions!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: ...The two of us?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I'm talking about the Trainer! Don't you 
know? Conquering three divisions is...—

text_block_list.name: Pink-Lipped Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, did you see that video?

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
A video? ...No, I'm not really well-versed 
in that area.

text_block_list.name: Ash-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
A fan made a video compilation of the 
challenge to conquer three distance 
categories.

text_block_list.name: Ash-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
It's documentary-style, really well made. 
You're in it too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text: …………In a video? Me?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
They've really multiplied in such a short 
time! Fan-made videos about Gran, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"There are even 'compilation videos'... 
that round up comments from my videos."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"She even fills in any missing 
explanations for me, so it's a huge help♪"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Old fans are teaching new fans all sorts 
of things, you know? And then new videos 
get made based on that.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: What incredible vitality!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The video about conquering three distance 
categories was wonderful too! It even had 
a storyline, yes!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It's a documentary-style video, isn't it? 
I-I love those too...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Inheriting the dying wish of their master 
before retirement, the pupil and her 
Umamusume challenge the three-division 
conquest.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I know it as a fact, but when you tell it 
as a story, it's so dramatic...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I truly want Gran-san to achieve it! If 
it's okay with me, I'll spare no effort to 
help!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I've already been in your care for another 
100 miles! I look forward to continuing to 
work with you!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
There's certainly a lively... conversation 
going on about conquering three distance 
categories.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Because we really wanted to spread 
our master's teachings!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: "Just as intended"—huh.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yes, just as planned!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
We won't let the teachings we inherited 
from Master end with just us.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
—Spread it, and pass it on. Toward the 
future of all Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Pink-Lipped Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...I was so happy. To see so many fans 
praising how wonderful you are, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Pink-Lipped Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Seeing the things you've built, Trainer, 
living on inside everyone.

text_block_list.name: Ash-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...We'll carry it forward, too. We'll keep 
the baton moving.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text: ...I see...

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Haha, man... I really didn't see this 
coming...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Trainer, is the camera all set?
choice_data_list:
Yeah. Feel free to start whenever you'd 
like.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Well then...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Good Mile-ning! It's Gran Alegria!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Today, I have an announcement for everyone 
about my next race!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Our next race is... the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Tokyo Racecourse's 1.25 miles! —That's 
right, a medium distance!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
The best middle-distance runners gather at 
the Tenno Sho (Autumn). That's why I chose 
it.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"If I don't become the strongest, then 
conquering all three divisions is 
meaningless!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ...And everyone from my generation.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting! See you at the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn)!
